'''Pokémon Ranger: The Comic – Shadows of Almia''' (Japanese: ダークライ ミッションストーリー ポケモンレンジャー バトナージ ''Darkrai Mission Story: Pokémon Ranger Vatonage - the Comic'') is a [[Pokémon manga]] adaptation of [[Pokémon Ranger: Shadows of Almia]]. It is written by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and illustrated by [[Satoshi Yamamoto]]. 

The manga was available online to members of the [[Pokémon Daisuki Club]] and is not available in printed book form.
